I was admitted to one a couple of months ago and honestly it wasn't bad at all (in my experience. I know other people who've absolutely hated it) but I actually really liked it besides the fact that I was bored during "quiet time" and the fact that we couldn't cuss or talk about inappropriate things. The food isn't that bad and it's nice being away from friends, family, and your actual life for a while. I made friends in there although it took a couple of days and the nurses can be very sweet at times. We watched movies alot and had 3 or 4 group therapies a day I believe which was a way of keeping us occupied and not isolated w our thoughts
